subject: Redwood demo — guest access blocked on calendar invite / propose host swap
message_1_headers:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@alcoveanalytics.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo scheduled for Wed 3/3
Attachments: redwood-demo-invite.ics (calendar invite stub)
message_1_body:
Hey Rishi,

Quick heads up — Sam (copied) tried to join the demo from Alcove and hit a ‘Request access’ page when clicking the calendar join button. We were sent a Google Meet link in the invite (see attached .ics) but our GSuite tenant is blocking the organizer’s domain for external guests.

Can you resend as a Zoom link or swap the host to a Redwood account that’s allowed to accept outside guests? We’re still good for the same time tomorrow (Wed 3/3 11:00am PT) but don’t want the whole session to get held up by permissions.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Moreno
Director, Platform Partnerships
Alcove Analytics
alex@alcoveanalytics.com
(415) 555-0198
message_2_headers:
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex@alcoveanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo scheduled for Wed 3/3
Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (preview)
message_2_body:
Hi Alex — thanks for flagging this.

Sorry for the friction. Two quick options:
1) I can reissue a Zoom meeting from my account and send a new invite/ics immediately (Zoom link + passcode).
2) Marissa can take host duties from her Redwood account (different domain) and we resend the invite so your users' tenant will allow the join.

If you prefer Zoom, I’ll create it now and share the link. If you’d rather keep Meet, Marissa — can you claim hosting and resend the invite to Alcove?

I attached the deck we’ll walk through so Sam can scan ahead.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0142
message_3_headers:
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex@alcoveanalytics.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo scheduled for Wed 3/3 — taking host duties
Attachments: (none)
message_3_body:
Thanks Rishi — I’ll take host duties and resend.

Alex / Sam: I’m creating a fresh invite from marissa@redwood.ai and will include an alternative Zoom link and a Google Meet fallback in the invite description. Please accept the new invite when you get it. If your tenant still blocks the Meet link, use the Zoom URL — no passcode required.

I’ll also enable 'join before host' so you’re not blocked if our host-side SSO hiccups. If you want us to record, reply here and I’ll turn on recording.

– Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
message_4_headers:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@alcoveanalytics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo scheduled for Wed 3/3 — taking host duties
Attachments: (none)
message_4_body:
Perfect — thanks Marissa and Rishi.

We received the new invite and the Zoom link worked for Sam. Confirm we’re set for 3/3 11:00am PT. Please record — we’ll use the recording to share internally with folks who can’t attend.

One small ask: can you include the attendee list in the calendar event so Sam doesn’t have to hunt for the Zoom link in his mailbox? (Some of our folks rely on calendar details.)

See you tomorrow.

Alex
resolution_summary: Marissa reissued the calendar invite from marissa@redwood.ai with a Zoom primary link and Meet fallback. Guest tenant blocking prevented the original organizer domain from joining; swapping host resolved the issue. Recording requested by Alcove. New invite included recording enabled and attendee list in event details.
notes_for_internal_ops: If we see repeated tenant blocks from Alcove, add note to deal record RD-2027-031 and advise to default to Zoom-hosting for future Alcove demos. Track under sales playbook 'external-tenant-blocking' and tag Solutions Engineers.
